fields.description: Christmas Eve issue featuring a prominent Santa Claus-themed editorial/letter addressing Miami’s children and civic behavior, alongside holiday fiction by Dorothy Parmer. Includes local commentary and satire on Miami-area politics and governance (county commissioners, receiverships), legal and court delays, and federal administrative inequities affecting Miami. Covers disputes over greyhound racing and betting, tourism promotion, nightlife announcements, and sports coverage including a feature on boxer Gene Tunney. Contains letters to the editor on business practices, holidays, traffic signals, and employment bureau matters, plus extensive holiday advertising and notices (including a master’s sale and oil-drilling promotion).
